subject.title: amazon-bedrock provider: Haiku 4.5 inference profile ARN not supported; params.modelId override ignored

question: Should `amazon-bedrock` use `params.modelId` as the AWS Converse `modelId`, require the full profile id/ARN as the OpenClaw model id, or add provider-owned aliases for Haiku profile IDs?
rationale: All three paths could solve the reporter's case, but they define different long-term config and provider identity semantics.

options.title: Use Bedrock params.modelId override
options.body: Define `params.modelId` as a Bedrock-only request identity override so operators can keep friendly OpenClaw keys while routing to account-specific profile ARNs.

options.title: Require full profile refs
options.body: Keep `Model.id` as the only request identity and document that users must select the full Bedrock inference profile id or ARN directly.

options.title: Add provider aliases
options.body: Teach the Bedrock plugin selected aliases such as Haiku 4.5, accepting a larger provider-owned mapping surface.

recommendation.title: Use Bedrock params.modelId override
recommendation.body: Define `params.modelId` as a Bedrock-only request identity override so operators can keep friendly OpenClaw keys while routing to account-specific profile ARNs.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the Bedrock inference-profile discovery and region-injection work they introduced.
